config:
# Generated for J-1042, target: replica
Configuration PE_J1042 {
    Import-DscResource -ModuleName Microsoft365DSC -ModuleVersion 2.26.1015.1
    Node localhost {
        IntuneDeviceConfigurationPolicyWindows10 'Kiosk - Win10' {
            DisplayName                      = 'Kiosk - Win10'
            PasswordRequired                 = $true
            PasswordMinimumLength            = 14
            ScreenLockTimeoutMinutes         = 10
            DefenderScanType                 = 'full'
            DefenderMonitorFileActivity      = 'monitorAllFiles'
            FirewallEnabled                  = $true
            SmartScreenEnableAppInstallControl = $true
            BitLockerEncryptDevice           = $true
            Assignments                      = @('Group: All Devices')
            Ensure                           = 'Present'
            ApplicationId                    = $ConfigurationData.NonNodeData.ApplicationId
            TenantId                         = $ConfigurationData.NonNodeData.TenantId
            CertificateThumbprint            = $ConfigurationData.NonNodeData.CertificateThumbprint
        }
    }
}
